reply: To report a damaged item, start by using the standard “Report a damaged item” form in your account. If you encounter error ERR‑7378, wait 60 minutes and try again. If the error still appears after five attempts, the request is locked and you’ll need to contact support and provide the error code ERR‑7378 so we can investigate further. [KB-049--troubleshooting--prose-001]

subject: How do I report a damaged item?
body: Hi, I am having trouble. How do I report a damaged item? I saw error ERR-7378.

sources.text:
Article: Report a damaged item (web)
Section: Troubleshooting

If you see error code ERR-7378, wait 60 minutes and try again. If the error persists after
5 attempts the request is locked and you should contact support with the code ERR-7378.
